bibl.title: The Career of Some Officials in the Arsinoite Nome in the Early Second Century BC.
bibl.seg: Eddy Lanciers, The Career of Some Officials in the Arsinoite Nome in the Early Second Century BC.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Adamas (sitologos). - Argeios (epimeletes). - Ptolemaios (epimeletes). - Epimeletai of the Arsinoite nome in the 180s and 170s BC. - The oikonomoi Ptolemaios, Leonides and Diophantos(?). - Conclusion: the documents from the archive of the sitologos Adamas were written between c. 185 BC and 173 BC.
